contributions.title: Corrected the OWASP ASVS 5.0 logging chapter reference in claude-code-templates' AI agent audit specialist from V7 (Session Management) to V16 (Security Logging and Error Handling)
Added Suricata's release and end-of-life data to endoflife.date, sourced from OISF's EOL policy and ChangeLog
Fixed Cisco mcp-scanner's credential-harvesting YARA rule so it detects RSA, OpenSSH, EC and DSA private key headers, with tests
Corrected the GitHub MCP Server governance guide's description of organization controls for fine-grained personal access tokens against GitHub's own PAT policy documentation
Added an India DPDP Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025 red-team preset to promptfoo, mapping seven obligations to its existing attack plugins (flagship F1)
Proposed opt-in exploit intelligence (CISA KEV + FIRST EPSS) for Google osv-scanner findings, with a three-PR design (flagship F4)
Proposed filesystem/repo scanning and ML-KEM/SLH-DSA support for Trivy's cryptographic asset (CBOM) scanner (flagship F3)
Public comment on FedRAMP RFC-0035 (cryptographic module rules): proposed CycloneDX CBOM as the module inventory format, with per-algorithm validation and NIST post-quantum security levels

Tested the proposed assessment-results reference constraints for NIST OSCAL (#2296) against develop and the official examples, offered tests and extra risk checks, and reported a broken reference in the official POA&M example

Proposed an OSCAL catalog release artifact for CISA ScubaGear's Microsoft 365 secure configuration baselines, carrying the NIST SP 800-53 mappings (port of ScubaGoggles #1058); trial run produced 162 controls passing OSCAL CLI
Contributed an ISO/IEC 27001 design for modelling the Statement of Applicability and risk assessment in NIST OSCAL v2 (gap analysis, minimal proposal, open questions)
Reported a broken risk reference in NIST's official IFA POA&M example (risk-uuid points at a mitigating factor), found while testing OSCAL #2296 constraints
Corrected Prowler's RBI compliance framework, which was named as RBI-wide but is RBI's repealed framework for urban cooperative banks
Fixed a cross-site scripting hole in grokbot-clone's app-connect callback, reproduced before and after on a local server
Made grokbot-clone listen on localhost by default, closing a same-network account takeover through the dev login
Stopped a malformed WebSocket upgrade from crashing grokbot-clone's server, reproduced the crash and the fix on a local run
Closed an approval bypass where grokbot-clone's Composio sandbox tools could act without the user's approval
Fixed shoot.py argument parsing in MotionSites' claude-skill so --wait no longer sends screenshots to the wrong folder; verified before/after
Corrected Obscura's documented SSRF deny-set against the engine's is_forbidden_ip, adding the CGNAT, IPv6 link-local and special-purpose ranges it actually blocks
Fixed a SIGPIPE crash in bama's agent-cli template so the generated app survives an early CLI disconnect; reproduced and fixed with a focused Swift harness
Hardened grokbot-clone's approval handling so a missing or unknown decision can no longer silently approve a tool call
Stopped grokbot-clone routines from being scheduled to run every second (unbounded model-API cost)
Clamped grokbot-clone's conversation row limit so a negative or non-numeric value can't return the whole history
Answered the CycloneDX discussion on representing a component bundled inside another (HBase bundling a.jar) with a spec-cited recommendation
Fixed a proof-of-work parity bug in stack-diagram's gallery (server clamped to 32 bits while its own Python client refuses over 26); added a regression test, full suite green
Confirmed with primary sources that Trivy v0.76.2 ships the go-jose v4.1.6 fix for CVE-2026-116587 (GHSA-mgcc-cww5-fp2q)
Answered a researcher's question on real-world PQC migration challenges with a practitioner breakdown across discovery, inventory, migration and compliance
Fixed a hang in uncut where cancelling a running tool command leaked the shell's child processes (co-authored with Tausif Ahmed); regression test proves 20s hang -> 0.5s
Added an India obligation reference set (RBI FREE-AI, DPDP Act and Rules, CERT-In Directions) to the FINOS AI Governance Framework, mapped to 14 risks
perf(render): opacity and color inline style writes force a full relayout on the next read, transform writes do not
fetch: writing to a closed pipe panics and exits 1 (| head, | grep -q)
Corrected the NIST AI RMF skill's GOVERN 3, 5 and 6 subcategories against NIST AI 100-1 Table 1 (19 subcategories, not 21)
Corrected the EU AI Act specialist skill's Article 43(1) conformity route for Annex III biometrics systems
Updated promptfoo's EU AI Act application dates to match Regulation (EU) 2026/1744
Flagged PCI DSS requirement titles in the pci-compliance skill that are no longer current
Added 11 rows to ShorList for generic PEM keys and certificates and for ML-KEM-768 and ML-DSA-65 key files as OpenSSL writes them, each with a primary source
Made the scanner read a post-quantum key's parameter set (ML-KEM-768, ML-DSA-65) from its identifier, so CNSA 2.0 and national profile checks see key and certificate files
Closed the open item on the executive order behind the CISA/NIST CBOM minimum elements (EO 14412 Sec. 5(d)) and corrected OMB M-23-02 and NIST IR 8547 dates in the docs
Showed the EU AI Act Article 5(1a) ban is narrower than the project's deadline entry, and that Article 4 on AI literacy was replaced by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744
Confirmed EU AI Act Annex IV against the Official Journal text of Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, closing an open item in the project's standards record
